neighbours.label: the word family 'coordination / coordinated / coordinating' (organizing parts to work together), as against near synonyms such as partnership, collaboration or organization
fire: The rescue was carried out in coordination with the coast guard and two fishing crews.
Poor coordination between the ministries delayed the vaccine rollout.
Young gymnasts spend hours improving their balance and coordination.
The two airlines coordinated their schedules to shorten layovers.
Her job involves coordinating deliveries across four warehouses.
The summit called for closer coordination of tax policy among member states.
Without coordination, each town built its own small water plant.
The chemists studied the coordination geometry of the copper complex.
quiet: The rescue was carried out together with the coast guard and two fishing crews.
Poor communication between the ministries delayed the vaccine rollout.
Young gymnasts spend hours improving their balance and flexibility.
The two airlines changed their schedules to shorten layovers.
Her job involves tracking deliveries across four warehouses.
The summit called for closer alignment of tax policy among member states.
Without planning, each town built its own small water plant.
The chemists studied the crystal structure of the copper complex.
